boundary: Exact linear-algebraic decoder. Realizing an orthonormal H1 sensor basis, analog calibration, ADC noise correlations, and hardware cost are open.
construction: Choose Z with 81 orthonormal rows spanning ker(D), and measure M=[D;Z].
global_stability: For arbitrary real edge error e and measurement y=Me+n, least squares obeys ||ehat-e||_2 <= ||n||_2.
relationship_to_sparse_decoder: The two 15-bit modular moments remain the compressed lattice-amplitude mode; the Hodge-complete 81-cycle-channel fallback trades channel count for global real-amplitude conditioning and does not require sparsity.
